scope.style: Sculpted and painted Arena of Fate treatment; noble and gardened Arenarea; dense cosmopolitan Martpart.
scope.extent: Complete districts and named landmarks, existing quests and transitions preserved.
scope.scale: District extents and building proportions may change; preserve landmark neighbourhoods and primary reference routes.
scope.access: Streets, squares, gardens, quays and important interiors accessible; ordinary houses mainly exterior; roofs and walls where a route is provided.
scope.transitions: Three separate maps with coherent streets and existing arrival contracts.
scope.ambience: Water, vegetation, cloth wind, fire, smoke, local sound and moderate animated ambient population.
scope.production: Small simple Blender parts assembled into reusable complex modules, reproducible sources.
scope.review: Latest instruction authorizes direct complete construction; intermediate engine reviews do not require another approval. Final artistic acceptance remains the author's.
